physicalNotes: Radius 0.23194578 Jupiter radii from Polanski et al. 2024 (2024ApJS..272...32P), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024ApJS..272...32P/abstract): 16,582.3 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. No mass is measured: Polanski et al. 2024 (2024ApJS..272...32P), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024ApJS..272...32P/abstract) gives only an upper limit of 0.02517081 Jupiter masses, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.

sources.phase: Polanski et al. 2024 (2024ApJS..272...32P), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname POLANSKI_ET_AL__2024): transit mid-time 2459739.67 BJD, taken as BJD_TDB; with its period, the row that predicts 2026-01-01 best (1 sigma 9 min)
sources.orientation: Display convention: transit photometry does not measure the orbit's position angle on the sky, so the ascending node is set at position angle 0 (celestial north).
